sources.title: Design and Implementation of High-throughput PCIe with DMA Architecture between FPGA and PowerPC
sources.snippet: We designed and implemented a direct memory access (DMA) architecture of PCI-Express(PCIe) between Xilinx Field Program Gate Array(FPGA) and Freescale PowerPC. The DMA architecture based on FPGA is compatible with the Xilinx PCIe core while the DMA architecture based on POWERPC is compatible with VxBus of VxWorks.
